notes: Write pages inside the app: a page editor with headings, lists, tables and pictures, where the page you see is the page you get. Opening a PDF from Finder with Open With now opens the document. Drawn signatures no longer come out as broken lines. Scan on the home screen is now Create, which also starts a blank PDF. The privacy policy is under Help. Addresses Open and New doing nothing on macOS 10.15 Catalina. The download is about half the size.
